$comment: Halo — a single-practitioner skin studio. Built from doc/client-html/theme/Halo Template (standalone) (2).html and Halo Privacy Policy (standalone).html, rendered to doc/client-html/extracted/Halo.html and Halo-privacy.html. Shape per customer-runtime.md §2.
name: Halo Skin Studio
description: A quiet, warm design for a one-room skin studio. Serif display type on a sage palette, a priced treatment menu, memberships, and a UK GDPR privacy policy built in.
$seo: Halo owns 'skincare clinic website design UK' in doc/SEO-AND-PERFORMANCE.md §Per-page targets. Onyx holds the aesthetics half of what used to be one row, so the two clinical designs never compete for a phrase (how-to-work.md §6a).
$pages: Two pages in this version: the homepage the client drew, and the privacy policy they drew with it. About, Treatments and Contact are sections of the homepage in this design, not separate pages — adding them later is content, not code.

settings.$comment: Extensions beyond the shared core in theme-customer-base/inc/settings-contract.php. Only fields this design's shell and blocks actually read (customer-runtime.md §5.3).

shell.$comment: Halo owns namespaced site-header/site-footer blocks and parts: the header is a translucent bar with an inline booking pill and the footer is a dark four-column band, neither of which the shared shell draws.
